name: User Authentication & Dashboard Analytics
description: Verify complete authentication cycle, dashboard KPI ribbons, sales pipeline charts, and task widgets

planSteps.description: Verify email input, password input, and Sign In button are visible on the login card
Enter 'admin@flowcrm.local' into email input, 'FlowAdmin123!' into password input, and click Sign In
Assert successful login redirects to /dashboard with user badge 'Flow Admin' and role 'Admin'
Verify top dashboard KPI ribbon cards render: Total Leads, Active Opportunities, Pipeline Value, Won Revenue, and Tasks Due Today
Verify Dashboard panels render: Sales Pipeline, Leads by Source, Revenue chart, and My Tasks
